description: This study reads carrier dynamics from a photocurrent transient. The other study reads the same transient on a different material, so its measurement carries over directly.

this.intent: Carrier dynamics show in how a photocurrent decays.
this.technique: Transient photocurrent measurement after a short light pulse.

other.intent: Trapped carriers slow the decay of a photocurrent.
other.technique: Transient photocurrent measurement on thin films.
